title: Weak-to-Strong Generalization via Bregman Bias-Variance Decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2505.24313v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Weak-to-strong generalization (W2SG) is the phenomenon in which a powerful student model, trained on labels produced by a weaker teacher, ultimately outperforms the teacher on the target task. In this work, we theoretically investigate how W2SG can arise via a generalized bias-variance decomposition under Bregman divergence. We show that the expected population risk gap between the student and the teacher is characterized by the expected misfit between the two models. Unlike earlier misfit-based analyses, our theory removes several restrictive assumptions, e.g., it does not require the student hypothesis class to be convex. Our results indicate that W2SG is more likely when the student effectively approximates the teacher's posterior mean. Specializing to squared loss, we provide a sufficient condition (illustrated through a concrete example) under which the student converges to its posterior mean teacher; in particular, increasing t

translated_title: 通过Bregman偏差-方差分解的弱到强泛化
translated_abstract: 弱到强泛化（W2SG）是指一个强大的学生模型，在由较弱教师生成的标签上训练后，最终在目标任务上超越教师的现象。在本工作中，我们从理论上研究了W2SG如何通过Bregman散度下的广义偏差-方差分解而产生。我们表明，学生与教师之间的期望总体风险差距由两个模型之间的期望失配来表征。与早期基于失配的分析不同，我们的理论去除了几个限制性假设，例如，它不要求学生假设类为凸集。我们的结果表明，当学生有效逼近教师的后验均值时，W2SG更可能发生。针对平方损失，我们提供了一个充分条件（通过具体示例说明），在该条件下学生收敛到其后验均值教师；特别是，增加t（可能指训练轮次或模型复杂度）有助于此过程。
tldr: 本文通过Bregman偏差-方差分解理论，去除了凸性等限制性假设，揭示了弱到强泛化发生的机制，即学生模型逼近教师后验均值时更易实现超越。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the mechanism of weak-to-strong generalization via Bregman bias-variance decomposition, removing restrictive assumptions like convexity, showing that student models approximating the teacher's posterior mean are more likely to surpass the teacher.
